about: Hand-written lore per module. kind/group/peers/adj drive the stat sentences rebuilt by the editor (Bulk edits > Stat descriptions).

Car_SteelArmorSmall.name: Cardassian Galor Hull Plate (Small)
Car_SteelArmorSmall.lore: Hull plate of uridium alloy, a staple of Cardassian shipbuilding. Plain, in the ochre of the Union's fleets, and sound enough to bring a ship home. "...could not defend itself against one Cardassian warship..." (Gul Jasad, DS9: "Emissary")

Car_SteelArmorMed.name: Cardassian Galor Hull Plate (Medium)
Car_SteelArmorMed.lore: Hull plate of uridium alloy, a staple of Cardassian shipbuilding. Plain, in the ochre of the Union's fleets, and sound enough to bring a ship home. "...could not defend itself against one Cardassian warship..." (Gul Jasad, DS9: "Emissary")

Car_PlaSteelArmorSmall.name: Cardassian Orbital Yard Laminate (Small)
Car_PlaSteelArmorSmall.lore: A laminate rolled out in bulk at the orbital assembly yards above Cardassia Prime. There is always more of it.

Car_PlaSteelArmorMed.name: Cardassian Orbital Yard Laminate (Medium)
Car_PlaSteelArmorMed.lore: A laminate rolled out in bulk at the orbital assembly yards above Cardassia Prime. There is always more of it.

Car_PlaSteelArmorLarge.name: Cardassian Orbital Yard Laminate (Large)
Car_PlaSteelArmorLarge.lore: A laminate rolled out in bulk at the orbital assembly yards above Cardassia Prime. There is always more of it.

Car_Ceramic_Armor_Small.name: Cardassian Refinery Ceramic Plate (Small)
Car_Ceramic_Armor_Small.lore: Ceramic fired from the by-products of uridite ore, refined by the Union at stations like Terok Nor. The Union can turn it out in vast numbers.

Car_Ceramic_Armor_Med.name: Cardassian Refinery Ceramic Plate (Medium)
Car_Ceramic_Armor_Med.lore: Ceramic fired from the by-products of uridite ore, refined by the Union at stations like Terok Nor. The Union can turn it out in vast numbers.

Car_Ceramic_Armor_Large.name: Cardassian Refinery Ceramic Plate (Large)
Car_Ceramic_Armor_Large.lore: Ceramic fired from the by-products of uridite ore, refined by the Union at stations like Terok Nor. The Union can turn it out in vast numbers.

Car_CompositeAlloys_Small.name: Cardassian Gul Composite Plate (Small)
Car_CompositeAlloys_Small.lore: Uridium alloy bonded in layers with other metals. The Union cannot afford to waste ships, so the plate is made to keep them alive.

Car_CompositeAlloys_Med.name: Cardassian Gul Composite Plate (Medium)
Car_CompositeAlloys_Med.lore: Uridium alloy bonded in layers with other metals. The Union cannot afford to waste ships, so the plate is made to keep them alive.

Car_CompositeAlloys_Large.name: Cardassian Gul Composite Plate (Large)
Car_CompositeAlloys_Large.lore: Uridium alloy bonded in layers with other metals. The Union cannot afford to waste ships, so the plate is made to keep them alive.

Car_Crystal_Armor_Small.name: Cardassian Obsidian Lattice Plate (Small)
Car_Crystal_Armor_Small.lore: Crystal lattice plating, dark as obsidian, developed in the Obsidian Order's own laboratories. Its makers will not say how it works, only that it does.

Car_Crystal_Armor_Med.name: Cardassian Obsidian Lattice Plate (Medium)
Car_Crystal_Armor_Med.lore: Crystal lattice plating, dark as obsidian, developed in the Obsidian Order's own laboratories. Its makers will not say how it works, only that it does.

Car_Crystal_Armor_Large.name: Cardassian Obsidian Lattice Plate (Large)
Car_Crystal_Armor_Large.lore: Crystal lattice plating, dark as obsidian, developed in the Obsidian Order's own laboratories. Its makers will not say how it works, only that it does.

Car_ablative_ship_armor_Small.name: Cardassian Burn-Off Plate (Small)
Car_ablative_ship_armor_Small.lore: Ablative plate that burns away in layers, so the first hits fall on plating and not on the crew. The Union has plenty of plate and fewer ships than it needs.

Car_ablative_ship_armor_med.name: Cardassian Burn-Off Plate (Medium)
Car_ablative_ship_armor_med.lore: Ablative plate that burns away in layers, so the first hits fall on plating and not on the crew. The Union has plenty of plate and fewer ships than it needs.

Car_ablative_ship_armor_large.name: Cardassian Burn-Off Plate (Large)
Car_ablative_ship_armor_large.lore: Ablative plate that burns away in layers, so the first hits fall on plating and not on the crew. The Union has plenty of plate and fewer ships than it needs.

Car_ablative_armor_Small.name: Cardassian Station Ablative Plating (Small)
Car_ablative_armor_Small.lore: Ablative plating for the ring and pylons of a Nor-style station, whose pylons are packed with ore processing plant. Replaced after every siege. "Your home was built by Cardassians. Don't ever forget that." (Kira, DS9: "Civil Defense")

Car_ablative_armor_Med.name: Cardassian Station Ablative Plating (Medium)
Car_ablative_armor_Med.lore: Ablative plating for the ring and pylons of a Nor-style station, whose pylons are packed with ore processing plant. Replaced after every siege. "Your home was built by Cardassians. Don't ever forget that." (Kira, DS9: "Civil Defense")

Car_ablative_armor_Large.name: Cardassian Station Ablative Plating (Large)
Car_ablative_armor_Large.lore: Ablative plating for the ring and pylons of a Nor-style station, whose pylons are packed with ore processing plant. Replaced after every siege. "Your home was built by Cardassians. Don't ever forget that." (Kira, DS9: "Civil Defense")

Car_Organic_Bioplates_Small.name: Cardassian Reclamation Bioplate (Small)
Car_Organic_Bioplates_Small.lore: Living plate regrown from reclaimed waste. A people short of resources learn to waste nothing, armour included.

Car_Organic_Bioplates_Med.name: Cardassian Reclamation Bioplate (Medium)
Car_Organic_Bioplates_Med.lore: Living plate regrown from reclaimed waste. A people short of resources learn to waste nothing, armour included.

Car_Organic_Bioplates_Large.name: Cardassian Reclamation Bioplate (Large)
Car_Organic_Bioplates_Large.lore: Living plate regrown from reclaimed waste. A people short of resources learn to waste nothing, armour included.

Car_Organic_cristal_Small.name: Cardassian Reclaimed Crystal Plate (Small)
Car_Organic_cristal_Small.lore: Crystal grown through a living scaffold from reclaimed material, which seals cracks as they open.

Car_Organic_cristal_Armor_Med.name: Cardassian Reclaimed Crystal Plate (Medium)
Car_Organic_cristal_Armor_Med.lore: Crystal grown through a living scaffold from reclaimed material, which seals cracks as they open.

Car_Organic_cristal_Armor_Large.name: Cardassian Reclaimed Crystal Plate (Large)
Car_Organic_cristal_Armor_Large.lore: Crystal grown through a living scaffold from reclaimed material, which seals cracks as they open.

Car_small_polirised_orbital_armor.name: Cardassian Orbital Ring Plate (Small)
Car_small_polirised_orbital_armor.lore: Polarised plating for a station's habitat ring, tuned to bleed off energy fire and built to hold through a long siege.

Car_med_polirised_orbital_armor.name: Cardassian Orbital Ring Plate (Medium)
Car_med_polirised_orbital_armor.lore: Polarised plating for a station's habitat ring, tuned to bleed off energy fire and built to hold through a long siege.

Car_large_polirised_orbital_armor.name: Cardassian Orbital Ring Plate (Large)
Car_large_polirised_orbital_armor.lore: Polarised plating for a station's habitat ring, tuned to bleed off energy fire and built to hold through a long siege.

Fed_SteelArmorSmall.name: Starfleet Duranium Hull Plate (Small)
Fed_SteelArmorSmall.lore: Duranium alloy plate, the standard hull armour of Starfleet starships. Plain, dependable, and repairable at any dock in the Federation.

Fed_SteelArmorMed.name: Starfleet Duranium Hull Plate (Medium)
Fed_SteelArmorMed.lore: Duranium alloy plate, the standard hull armour of Starfleet starships. Plain, dependable, and repairable at any dock in the Federation.

Fed_SteelArmorLarge.name: Starfleet Duranium Hull Plate (Large)
Fed_SteelArmorLarge.lore: Duranium alloy plate, the standard hull armour of Starfleet starships. Plain, dependable, and repairable at any dock in the Federation.

Fed_PlaSteelArmorSmall.name: Starfleet Transparent Aluminium Plate (Small)
Fed_PlaSteelArmorSmall.lore: Transparent aluminium, the strong clear material of Starfleet viewports and cargo bay walls, laminated in layers and rolled opaque for use as hull plate. Its aluminium oxynitride matrix is aligned at the molecular level, so it is far stronger than it looks.

Fed_PlaSteelArmorMed.name: Starfleet Transparent Aluminium Plate (Medium)
Fed_PlaSteelArmorMed.lore: Transparent aluminium, the strong clear material of Starfleet viewports and cargo bay walls, laminated in layers and rolled opaque for use as hull plate. Its aluminium oxynitride matrix is aligned at the molecular level, so it is far stronger than it looks.

Fed_PlaSteelArmorLarge.name: Starfleet Transparent Aluminium Plate (Large)
Fed_PlaSteelArmorLarge.lore: Transparent aluminium, the strong clear material of Starfleet viewports and cargo bay walls, laminated in layers and rolled opaque for use as hull plate. Its aluminium oxynitride matrix is aligned at the molecular level, so it is far stronger than it looks.

Fed_Ceramic_Armor_Small.name: Starfleet Ceramic Composite Plate (Small)
Fed_Ceramic_Armor_Small.lore: A ceramic layer bonded to a duranium backing. The ceramic is seeded with a fractal lattice that shatters on impact and spreads the shock across the whole plate, so the backing is never loaded at a single point.

Fed_Ceramic_Armor_Med.name: Starfleet Ceramic Composite Plate (Medium)
Fed_Ceramic_Armor_Med.lore: A ceramic layer bonded to a duranium backing. The ceramic is seeded with a fractal lattice that shatters on impact and spreads the shock across the whole plate, so the backing is never loaded at a single point.

Fed_Ceramic_Armor_Large.name: Starfleet Ceramic Composite Plate (Large)
Fed_Ceramic_Armor_Large.lore: A ceramic layer bonded to a duranium backing. The ceramic is seeded with a fractal lattice that shatters on impact and spreads the shock across the whole plate, so the backing is never loaded at a single point.

Fed_CompositeAlloys_Small.name: Starfleet Tritanium Composite Plate (Small)
Fed_CompositeAlloys_Small.lore: Tritanium alloy, the hull and bulkhead metal of Galaxy- and Intrepid-class starships, laid in layers. Tritanium in its pure form is 21.4 times as hard as diamond.

Fed_CompositeAlloys_Med.name: Starfleet Tritanium Composite Plate (Medium)
Fed_CompositeAlloys_Med.lore: Tritanium alloy, the hull and bulkhead metal of Galaxy- and Intrepid-class starships, laid in layers. Tritanium in its pure form is 21.4 times as hard as diamond.

Fed_CompositeAlloys_Large.name: Starfleet Tritanium Composite Plate (Large)
Fed_CompositeAlloys_Large.lore: Tritanium alloy, the hull and bulkhead metal of Galaxy- and Intrepid-class starships, laid in layers. Tritanium in its pure form is 21.4 times as hard as diamond.

Fed_Crystal_Armor_Small.name: Starfleet Utopia Planitia Laminate (Small)
Fed_Crystal_Armor_Small.lore: A crystalline laminate grown in the fabrication bays of the Utopia Planitia yards above Mars, with its atoms aligned along the line of the hull stress. The lattice vibrates at a resonant frequency, so a hit is spread through the crystal before it can crack.

Fed_Crystal_Armor_Med.name: Starfleet Utopia Planitia Laminate (Medium)
Fed_Crystal_Armor_Med.lore: A crystalline laminate grown in the fabrication bays of the Utopia Planitia yards above Mars, with its atoms aligned along the line of the hull stress. The lattice vibrates at a resonant frequency, so a hit is spread through the crystal before it can crack.

Fed_Crystal_Armor_Large.lore: A crystalline laminate grown in the fabrication bays of the Utopia Planitia yards above Mars, with its atoms aligned along the line of the hull stress. The lattice vibrates at a resonant frequency, so a hit is spread through the crystal before it can crack.

Fed_ablative_ship_armor_Small.name: Starfleet Ablative Hull Armour (Small)
Fed_ablative_ship_armor_Small.lore: Ablative armour, as fitted to the USS Defiant: layers that burn away under fire and leave the hull beneath whole.

Fed_ablative_ship_armor_med.name: Starfleet Ablative Hull Armour (Medium)
Fed_ablative_ship_armor_med.lore: Ablative armour, as fitted to the USS Defiant: layers that burn away under fire and leave the hull beneath whole.

Fed_ablative_ship_armor_large.name: Starfleet Ablative Hull Armour (Large)
Fed_ablative_ship_armor_large.lore: Ablative armour, as fitted to the USS Defiant: layers that burn away under fire and leave the hull beneath whole.

Fed_ablative_armor_Small.name: Starfleet Starbase Ablative Plating (Small)
Fed_ablative_armor_Small.lore: Ablative plating for a starbase ring, replaced in sections once it has taken a beating.

Fed_ablative_armor_Med.name: Starfleet Starbase Ablative Plating (Medium)
Fed_ablative_armor_Med.lore: Ablative plating for a starbase ring, replaced in sections once it has taken a beating.

Fed_ablative_armor_Large.name: Starfleet Starbase Ablative Plating (Large)
Fed_ablative_armor_Large.lore: Ablative plating for a starbase ring, replaced in sections once it has taken a beating.

Fed_Organic_Bioplates_Small.name: Starfleet Regenerative Bioplate (Small)
Fed_Organic_Bioplates_Small.lore: Plate grown on a bio-neural substrate, a living gel that senses damage and lays down new material at the edge of a breach. The substrate is tuned to the ship's own power grid, and the plate knits itself whole between engagements.

Fed_Organic_Bioplates_Med.name: Starfleet Regenerative Bioplate (Medium)
Fed_Organic_Bioplates_Med.lore: Plate grown on a bio-neural substrate, a living gel that senses damage and lays down new material at the edge of a breach. The substrate is tuned to the ship's own power grid, and the plate knits itself whole between engagements.

Fed_Organic_Bioplates_Large.name: Starfleet Regenerative Bioplate (Large)
Fed_Organic_Bioplates_Large.lore: Plate grown on a bio-neural substrate, a living gel that senses damage and lays down new material at the edge of a breach. The substrate is tuned to the ship's own power grid, and the plate knits itself whole between engagements.

Fed_Organic_cristal_Small.name: Starfleet Bio-Crystalline Plate (Small)
Fed_Organic_cristal_Small.lore: A crystal lattice seeded on a bio-neural scaffold, which seals hairline cracks as they open. A trickle of power through the scaffold keeps the crystal growing back to its original pattern.

Fed_Organic_cristal_Armor_Med.name: Starfleet Bio-Crystalline Plate (Medium)
Fed_Organic_cristal_Armor_Med.lore: A crystal lattice seeded on a bio-neural scaffold, which seals hairline cracks as they open. A trickle of power through the scaffold keeps the crystal growing back to its original pattern.

Fed_Organic_cristal_Armor_Large.name: Starfleet Bio-Crystalline Plate (Large)
Fed_Organic_cristal_Armor_Large.lore: A crystal lattice seeded on a bio-neural scaffold, which seals hairline cracks as they open. A trickle of power through the scaffold keeps the crystal growing back to its original pattern.

Fed_small_polirised_orbital_armor.name: Starfleet Polarised Hull Plating (Small)
Fed_small_polirised_orbital_armor.lore: Polarised plating, a current run through the hull to stiffen it against impact. It was in use before shields, and still guards the rings of starbases.

Fed_med_polirised_orbital_armor.name: Starfleet Polarised Hull Plating (Medium)
Fed_med_polirised_orbital_armor.lore: Polarised plating, a current run through the hull to stiffen it against impact. It was in use before shields, and still guards the rings of starbases.

Fed_large_polirised_orbital_armor.name: Starfleet Polarised Hull Plating (Large)
Fed_large_polirised_orbital_armor.lore: Polarised plating, a current run through the hull to stiffen it against impact. It was in use before shields, and still guards the rings of starbases.

Car_Fighter_Shield.name: Cardassian Hideki Shield Emitter
Car_Fighter_Shield.lore: Emitter for the Hideki-pattern fighters the Union flew as pickets and escorts. Good enough against energy fire, and little help against debris and solid shot.

Car_advanced_fighter_sheaild.name: Cardassian Hideki Reinforced Emitter
Car_advanced_fighter_sheaild.lore: A refit of the Hideki emitter with a larger coil, for the fighters kept at the edge of a battle to pick off stragglers.

Car_prototype_fighter_shealds.name: Cardassian Skirmisher Prototype Grid
Car_prototype_fighter_shealds.lore: A trial grid built for the Central Command's small strike craft. Hurriedly fitted, and a step above the standard emitter.

Car_transphasic_fighter_shealds.name: Cardassian Alliance-Pattern Fighter Grid
Car_transphasic_fighter_shealds.lore: Built after the Union joined the Dominion, on designs shared under the Alliance. It is the best a Cardassian fighter ever carried.

Car_freighter_sheaild.name: Cardassian Freighter Shield Generator
Car_freighter_sheaild.lore: Modest generator for the Union's freighters and transports, enough to turn away raiders and little else.

Car_Shield_1KW.name: Cardassian Patrol Shield Generator
Car_Shield_1KW.lore: The standard generator of the Union's small patrol craft and escorts.

Car_frigate_shealds.name: Cardassian Frigate Shield Grid
Car_frigate_shealds.lore: The grid carried by Cardassian frigates, the picket ships that kept order over worlds like Bajor.

Car_Shield_10KW.name: Cardassian Galor Shield Grid
Car_Shield_10KW.lore: The Galor-class carried its shield generators in the tail, aft of the hull. Heavy and thorough, it is the backbone of the Cardassian fleet.

Car_advanced_crusier_sheaild.name: Cardassian Keldon Shield Grid
Car_advanced_crusier_sheaild.lore: The Keldon-class shares the Galor's hull with an extra superstructure, and a stronger grid to match. Its shields take energy fire well.

Car_ArmoredShield4x4.name: Cardassian Armoured Shield Casing
Car_ArmoredShield4x4.lore: Emitters buried in a hardened casing, so the shield can fail without the ship losing the generator.

Car_CanopyShield.name: Cardassian Hegemony Canopy Shield
Car_CanopyShield.lore: A wide canopy field thrown over the largest hulls of the Union's fleets, built to cover a whole formation.

Car_advanced_CanopyShields.name: Cardassian Dreadnought Canopy Shield
Car_advanced_CanopyShields.lore: The canopy field of the biggest Cardassian warships. Meant to cover a whole squadron at once.

Car_ORBITAL_SHEAILD_2X2.name: Cardassian Picket Field Generator
Car_ORBITAL_SHEAILD_2X2.lore: A field for the pickets and defence stations that guarded Union worlds.

Car_ORBITAL_SHEAILD_2X2_MK2.name: Cardassian Bulwark Field Generator
Car_ORBITAL_SHEAILD_2X2_MK2.lore: A larger field generator for the pickets, with a wider cover and a deeper store of power.

Car_TRANSPHASIC_OWP_SHEAILD.name: Cardassian Platform Regenerative Shield
Car_TRANSPHASIC_OWP_SHEAILD.lore: The regenerative force fields that made the orbital weapon platforms of the Chin'toka system nearly invulnerable to return fire. "Captain, I've just noticed something odd about those platforms." (Garak, DS9: "Tears of the Prophets")

Car_small_station_sheaild_mk1.name: Cardassian Pylon Shield Projector
Car_small_station_sheaild_mk1.lore: A projector for the pylons of a Nor-pattern station, where the ore processing plant sits.

Car_station_deflector_mk1.name: Cardassian Station Deflector Array
Car_station_deflector_mk1.lore: The main deflector array of a Cardassian station, built to keep an occupied world's skies under guard.

Car_starbase_sheailds.name: Cardassian Nor Station Shield Grid
Car_starbase_sheailds.lore: The full shield grid of a large Nor-pattern station, covering the ring and all three pylons.

Car_station_deflector_mk2.name: Cardassian Bastion Deflector
Car_station_deflector_mk2.lore: The deflector of the Union's greatest fortress stations, tuned to bounce the heaviest energy fire.

Fed_Fighter_Shield.name: Starfleet Runabout Deflector Emitter
Fed_Fighter_Shield.lore: Compact deflector emitter for shuttles and runabouts. It holds a single modulated shield frequency in the megahertz range, the same band as the shields of larger Starfleet ships.

Fed_advanced_fighter_sheaild.name: Starfleet Rotating-Frequency Emitter
Fed_advanced_fighter_sheaild.lore: The emitter steps through a rotating shield frequency, so an enemy that has matched one harmonic is thrown off at the next.

Fed_prototype_fighter_shealds.name: Starfleet Experimental Harmonic Emitter
Fed_prototype_fighter_shealds.lore: A test emitter that carries the shield harmonics on a tighter subspace field. It is a prototype, and the engineers still tune it by hand.

Fed_transphasic_fighter_shealds.name: Starfleet Transphasic Fighter Grid
Fed_transphasic_fighter_shealds.lore: Borrows the subspace compression pulse of transphasic weapons for its field, with a randomised phase pattern across the grid. An enemy has no steady frequency to learn.

Fed_freighter_sheaild.name: Starfleet Cargo Deflector Generator
Fed_freighter_sheaild.lore: A simple deflector generator for cargo haulers and tenders. It is built to turn away debris and the odd raider.

Fed_Shield_1KW.name: Starfleet Escort Deflector Generator
Fed_Shield_1KW.lore: The standard deflector generator of Starfleet escorts and patrol craft, with its emitters modulated across a narrow frequency band.

Fed_frigate_shealds.name: Starfleet Multiphasic Shield Grid
Fed_frigate_shealds.lore: A multiphasic grid, the advanced Federation deflector type that also shields against subspace radiation and the energy emissions of stars.

Fed_Shield_10KW.name: Starfleet Heavy Deflector Grid
Fed_Shield_10KW.lore: The main deflector grid of Starfleet cruisers, with its emitters spread over the hull to keep the field even.

Fed_advanced_crusier_sheaild.name: Starfleet Adaptive Harmonic Grid
Fed_advanced_crusier_sheaild.lore: The grid reads incoming fire and remodulates its shield harmonics to match, so each hit lands on a field already tuned against it.

Fed_ArmoredShield4x4.name: Starfleet Hardened Emitter Housing
Fed_ArmoredShield4x4.lore: Shield emitters set in a hardened housing and tied into the hull's structural integrity field, so the emitters survive a hit that breaks the shield.

Fed_CanopyShield.name: Starfleet Wide-Area Deflector Canopy
Fed_CanopyShield.lore: A canopy field drawn over the largest hulls from a ring of emitters, with the harmonics phase-locked across the whole span.

Fed_advanced_CanopyShields.name: Starfleet Transphasic Canopy Array
Fed_advanced_CanopyShields.lore: An experimental canopy that applies transphasic subspace compression to the field. The phase configuration is randomised so it cannot be predicted.

Fed_ORBITAL_SHEAILD_2X2.name: Starfleet Picket Deflector Generator
Fed_ORBITAL_SHEAILD_2X2.lore: A deflector for pickets and defence stations, powered from the station's own grid.

Fed_ORBITAL_SHEAILD_2X2_MK2.name: Starfleet Phase-Locked Platform Deflector
Fed_ORBITAL_SHEAILD_2X2_MK2.lore: A platform deflector with its emitters phase-locked into one field.

Fed_TRANSPHASIC_OWP_SHEAILD.name: Starfleet Transphasic Platform Shield
Fed_TRANSPHASIC_OWP_SHEAILD.lore: A transphasic shield for the largest platforms, with a subspace compression pulse that randomises the phase of the field.

Fed_small_station_sheaild_mk1.name: Starfleet Outpost Shield Emitter
Fed_small_station_sheaild_mk1.lore: A shield emitter for outposts and relay stations, tied to the station's structural integrity field.

Fed_station_deflector_mk1.name: Starfleet Starbase Deflector Array
Fed_station_deflector_mk1.lore: The main deflector array of a Starbase, with emitters on every pylon and rotating shield harmonics.

Fed_starbase_sheailds.name: Starfleet Starbase Shield Grid
Fed_starbase_sheailds.lore: The full shield grid of a large Starbase, with multiphasic emitters across the ring and the docking arms.

Fed_station_deflector_mk2.name: Starfleet Spacedock Deflector Array
Fed_station_deflector_mk2.lore: The deflector of the great Spacedock stations, with adaptive harmonics that follow every ship in the docking zone.

cardasian_fighter_beam.name: Cardassian Hideki Disruptor Array
cardasian_fighter_beam.lore: Light disruptor array for Hideki-pattern fighters. Disruptors break down the target's molecular bonds, and this one does it from a small hull.

Car_DisruptorBeamMk1.name: Cardassian Spiral-Wave Disruptor
Car_DisruptorBeamMk1.lore: The spiral-wave disruptor is the standard gun of Cardassian warships, with a firing arc wide enough for a long patrol.

Car_DisruptorBeamMk2.name: Cardassian Galor Spiral-Wave Array
Car_DisruptorBeamMk2.lore: The array carried by Galor-class cruisers, the workhorse of the Cardassian fleet.

Car_DisruptorBeamMk3.name: Cardassian Keldon Spiral-Wave Array
Car_DisruptorBeamMk3.lore: A heavier array for the Keldon-class, which shares the Galor's hull under a larger superstructure.

cardasian_prototype_beam.name: Cardassian Prototype Phase-Disruptor Array
cardasian_prototype_beam.lore: A trial array built for the Central Command's testing yards. Hand-tuned, and not yet ready for the line.

ADVANCED_cardasian_prototype_beam.name: Cardassian Experimental Nadion Array
ADVANCED_cardasian_prototype_beam.lore: An experimental array that pushes the rapid nadion effect of Cardassian disruptors past its normal limit.

Car_DisruptorCannonMk1.name: Cardassian Disruptor Wave Cannon
Car_DisruptorCannonMk1.lore: The aft disruptor wave cannon of the Galor-class, a close-in weapon that fires in short bursts.

Car_DisruptorCannonMk2.name: Cardassian Heavy Wave Cannon
Car_DisruptorCannonMk2.lore: A larger wave cannon, fitted to heavier ships.

Car_DisruptorCannonMk3.name: Cardassian Siege Wave Cannon
Car_DisruptorCannonMk3.lore: The biggest wave cannon the Union ever mounted on a ship, meant for hammering defended worlds.

Car_PhotonTorpedoMk1.name: Cardassian Escort Torpedo Launcher
Car_PhotonTorpedoMk1.lore: A single-tube launcher for escorts and light cruisers.

Car_PhotonTorpedoMk2.name: Cardassian Galor Torpedo Launcher
Car_PhotonTorpedoMk2.lore: Launcher for the Galor-class, built to fit alongside the disruptor banks.

Car_PhotonTorpedoMk3.name: Cardassian Keldon Torpedo Launcher
Car_PhotonTorpedoMk3.lore: A heavier launcher for the Keldon-class.

Car_PhotonTorpedoMk4.name: Cardassian Dreadnought Torpedo Launcher
Car_PhotonTorpedoMk4.lore: A launcher for the largest cruisers of the fleet.

Car_HeavyPhotonTorpedoMk1.name: Cardassian Siege Torpedo Launcher
Car_HeavyPhotonTorpedoMk1.lore: A heavy launcher for ships built to break defended worlds.

Car_HeavyPhotonTorpedoMk2.name: Cardassian Fortress Torpedo Launcher
Car_HeavyPhotonTorpedoMk2.lore: The heaviest launcher in the fleet, made to reduce fortress stations.

cardassian_prototype_torpedo.name: Cardassian Experimental Torpedo Launcher
cardassian_prototype_torpedo.lore: An experimental launcher, still on the testing range.

Car_orbital_weapons_platform.name: Cardassian Weapon Platform Disruptor Array
Car_orbital_weapons_platform.lore: An orbital weapon platform carried three disruptor arrays. Many were built to guard the home worlds so the fleet could be used offensively.

Car_orbital_cannons.name: Cardassian System-5 Defence Disruptor
Car_orbital_cannons.lore: The System-5 disruptor was a planetary defence weapon, never designed to move. It guarded outposts like Korma.

Car_orbital_cannons_mk1.name: Cardassian Orbital Disruptor Cannon
Car_orbital_cannons_mk1.lore: A heavy disruptor cannon for a station's ring.

Car_orbital_cannons_mk2.name: Cardassian Ring Disruptor Battery
Car_orbital_cannons_mk2.lore: A battery of cannons spread around a station's habitat ring.

Car_orbital_cannons_mk3.name: Cardassian Pylon Disruptor Battery
Car_orbital_cannons_mk3.lore: A battery mounted on the pylons of a Nor-pattern station.

Car_orbital_cannons_mk4.name: Cardassian Bastion Disruptor Battery
Car_orbital_cannons_mk4.lore: The largest battery in the Union's fortress stations, covering whole sectors of sky.

Car_station_phasor_beem_mk1.name: Cardassian Outpost Disruptor Lance
Car_station_phasor_beem_mk1.lore: A lance for outposts, firing a narrow beam.

Car_station_phasor_beem_mk2.name: Cardassian Ring Disruptor Array
Car_station_phasor_beem_mk2.lore: A beam array for a station's ring.

Car_station_phasor_beem_mk3.name: Cardassian Pylon Disruptor Array
Car_station_phasor_beem_mk3.lore: A beam array for the pylons of a Nor-pattern station.

Car_station_phasor_beem_mk4.name: Cardassian Bastion Lance
Car_station_phasor_beem_mk4.lore: The long lance of the Union's fortress stations, which no ship can safely approach.

Car_orbital_defence_torpedo.name: Cardassian Defence Torpedo Tube
Car_orbital_defence_torpedo.lore: A fixed tube for stations and garrisons.

Car_station_torpedo_launcher_mk1.name: Cardassian Garrison Torpedo Launcher
Car_station_torpedo_launcher_mk1.lore: A launcher for a station's garrison, kept loaded in case of attack.

Car_station_torpedo_launcher_mk2.name: Cardassian Reinforced Garrison Launcher
Car_station_torpedo_launcher_mk2.lore: A garrison launcher with a reinforced magazine.

Car_station_adv_torpedo_mk1.name: Cardassian Advanced Siege Launcher
Car_station_adv_torpedo_mk1.lore: A long-reach launcher used to hold off a fleet at a distance.

Car_station_hevey_torpedo_mk1.name: Cardassian Heavy Bombardment Launcher
Car_station_hevey_torpedo_mk1.lore: The heaviest launcher on a Cardassian station, built to crack a fleet.

Phasor_Beam_mk1.name: Starfleet Type-VI Phaser Array
Phasor_Beam_mk1.lore: A phased array that fires a stream of nadion-charged energy, with each emitter fed from the warp plasma grid.

Phasor_Beam_mk2.name: Starfleet Type-VIII Phaser Array
Phasor_Beam_mk2.lore: A heavier array with a phase-modulated pulse.

Phasor_Beam_mk3.name: Starfleet Type-X Phaser Array
Phasor_Beam_mk3.lore: The array of the Federation's great cruisers, with the beam focused through a rotating phase discriminator.

fighter_power_drain_phasor.name: Starfleet Fighter Disruption Phaser
fighter_power_drain_phasor.lore: A compact phaser for fighters that bleeds the power grid of whatever it hits.

modulated_phasor.name: Starfleet Modulated Phaser Array
modulated_phasor.lore: A phaser whose pulse is modulated across many frequencies at once, so it finds the gaps in a hull's plating.

power_drain_phasor_beam_4x4.name: Starfleet Power-Drain Phaser Lance
power_drain_phasor_beam_4x4.lore: A heavy phaser lance tuned to overload a target's power grid rather than burn its hull.

Fed_PhaserCannon.name: Starfleet Phase Cannon
Fed_PhaserCannon.lore: A phase cannon, the forerunner of the modern phaser. It fires a short bolt of phased energy and needs little to keep it running.

Fed_PhaserCannon_2x2.name: Starfleet Pulse Phase Cannon
Fed_PhaserCannon_2x2.lore: A phase cannon that fires in pulses, each one a fresh bolt of phased energy.

Fed_PhaserCannon_3x3.name: Starfleet Rapid-Pulse Phaser Cannon
Fed_PhaserCannon_3x3.lore: A larger pulse cannon, driven by a faster phase cycle for sustained fire.

Fed_Hevey_PhaserCannon_3x3.name: Starfleet Heavy Pulse Phaser Cannon
Fed_Hevey_PhaserCannon_3x3.lore: The heavy cannon of the line, built for slow, hard-hitting pulses.

Fed_PhotonTorpedo_Mk1.name: Starfleet Photon Torpedo Launcher
Fed_PhotonTorpedo_Mk1.lore: The standard matter-antimatter launcher of Starfleet ships. Each torpedo carries a measure of matter and antimatter, held apart in a magnetic bottle until impact.

Fed_PhotonTorpedo_Mk2.name: Starfleet Advanced Photon Launcher
Fed_PhotonTorpedo_Mk2.lore: A refit launcher with a better magnetic bottle and faster loading.

Fed_HeavyPhotonTorpedo_Mk1.name: Starfleet Heavy Photon Launcher
Fed_HeavyPhotonTorpedo_Mk1.lore: A heavy launcher for ships that need to break a hull and not just a shield.

Fed_HeavyPhotonTorpedo_Mk2.name: Starfleet High-Yield Photon Launcher
Fed_HeavyPhotonTorpedo_Mk2.lore: A launcher tuned for a high-yield warhead, with a larger antimatter charge.

Fed_Photonstorm.name: Starfleet Photon Torpedo Spread Launcher
Fed_Photonstorm.lore: A launcher that fires a spread of photon torpedoes in one burst, each pre-set to its own flight pattern.

Fed_QuantumTorpedo_Mk1.name: Starfleet Quantum Torpedo Launcher
Fed_QuantumTorpedo_Mk1.lore: A launcher for quantum torpedoes, which draw their yield from vacuum energy.

Fed_QuantumTorpedo_Mk2.name: Starfleet Quantum Torpedo Array
Fed_QuantumTorpedo_Mk2.lore: An improved array for quantum torpedoes, with a compact warhead and a refined vacuum-energy core.

Fed_orbital_weapons_platform.name: Starfleet Weapon Platform Phaser Array
Fed_orbital_weapons_platform.lore: A phaser array for automated defence platforms in orbit, fed from the platform's own power grid.

Fed_orbital_cannons.name: Starfleet Defence Phaser Bank
Fed_orbital_cannons.lore: A fixed phaser bank for a planetary defence post, aimed by the station's tactical computer.

Fed_orbital_cannons_mk1.name: Starfleet Orbital Phaser Cannon
Fed_orbital_cannons_mk1.lore: A heavy phaser cannon for a Starbase's ring.

Fed_orbital_cannons_mk2.name: Starfleet Ring Phaser Battery
Fed_orbital_cannons_mk2.lore: A battery of phaser cannons set around the ring of a Starbase.

Fed_orbital_cannons_mk3.name: Starfleet Spacedock Phaser Battery
Fed_orbital_cannons_mk3.lore: A battery fitted to the arms of a Spacedock.

Fed_orbital_cannons_mk4.name: Starfleet Starbase Phaser Battery
Fed_orbital_cannons_mk4.lore: The largest phaser battery on a Starbase, with an emitter spread wide to cover a whole sector of sky.

Fed_station_phasor_beem_mk1.name: Starfleet Outpost Phaser Lance
Fed_station_phasor_beem_mk1.lore: A phaser lance for outposts, firing a narrow beam through a tight phase discriminator.

Fed_station_phasor_beem_mk2.name: Starfleet Starbase Phaser Array
Fed_station_phasor_beem_mk2.lore: A phased array for a Starbase, with an array of emitters on the ring.

Fed_station_phasor_beem_mk3.name: Starfleet Spacedock Phaser Array
Fed_station_phasor_beem_mk3.lore: A phased array for a Spacedock, fed by the full power of the station.

Fed_station_phasor_beem_mk4.name: Starfleet Defence Grid Phaser Lance
Fed_station_phasor_beem_mk4.lore: The heavy lance of the Federation's defence grid, focused through a rotating phase discriminator.

Fed_orbital_defence_torpedo.name: Starfleet Defence Torpedo Tube
Fed_orbital_defence_torpedo.lore: A fixed torpedo tube for stations and garrisons.

Fed_station_torpedo_launcher_mk1.name: Starfleet Starbase Torpedo Launcher
Fed_station_torpedo_launcher_mk1.lore: A launcher for a Starbase's garrison, kept loaded in case of attack.

Fed_station_torpedo_launcher_mk2.name: Starfleet Reinforced Starbase Launcher
Fed_station_torpedo_launcher_mk2.lore: A Starbase launcher with a reinforced magazine.

Fed_station_adv_torpedo_mk1.name: Starfleet Quantum Torpedo Battery
Fed_station_adv_torpedo_mk1.lore: A battery of quantum torpedoes, with the vacuum-energy cores held in a shielded magazine.

Fed_station_hevey_torpedo_mk1.name: Starfleet Transphasic Torpedo Battery
Fed_station_hevey_torpedo_mk1.lore: The heaviest battery on a Starbase. Its torpedoes use a subspace compression pulse with a randomised phase pattern, which no shield can predict.
